description: This file defines a Java interface for accessing Price entities in a database using Spring Data JPA. It extends JpaRepository and includes a custom query method to find active prices by store code, SKU, and currency code.

classes.name: PriceRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for Price entities, providing CRUD operations and custom find method.

methods.name: findByStoreCodeAndSkuAndCurrencyCodeAndActiveIsTrue
methods.description: Finds an active Price by store code, SKU, and currency code, returning an Optional<Price>.
